Open Interpreter

A coding agent optimized for low-cost models. Blog post ↗


### Installation macOS and Linux: ```bash curl -fsSL https://www.openinterpreter.com/install | sh ``` Windows: ```powershell irm https://www.openinterpreter.com/install.ps1 | iex ``` Then type `i` or `interpreter` in your terminal to start a session. ### Harness Emulation Open Interpreter is a fork of OpenAI's Codex, with a focus on emulating the agent harness that gets the best performance out of low-cost models.
